# Commands diff viewer navigation and conditional VS Code integration

File-summary markup comes from `commands/graph/diff-renderer.mjs`; delegated interaction belongs in `commands/graph/client/diff-viewer.js` and `init.js`. `handleDiffFileClick` matches `.pretty-file` by `data-file-path` and calls `scrollIntoView`; click and Enter passed including renamed filenames with spaces. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
